payload.title: UI Controller v4: concurrency fixes

fixes.concurrent_admission: Dispatch-wide RLock serializes entire critical section (admission check -> journal -> token validate -> dispatch -> confirm). 10-thread test: exactly 1 intent journaled.
fixes.shared_lock_state: Module-level registry keyed by path. All UILockV4 instances on same path share mutex and state. No split-brain.
fixes.token_toctou: Mutex held during entire dispatch including network I/O. Release() takes same lock path. Token validated twice under mutex.

payload.tests: 13/13 pass. Concurrent admission (10 threads), shared lock instances, token TOCTOU.
payload.tradeoff: Mutex held during network I/O (up to 15s timeout). Correct for single-operator UI automation.
payload.not_yet: No live input. Awaiting your v4 review.
